instruction: Modify Thunderbird IMAP settings to specify a chunk size of 106496 bytes and a minimum chunk size of 159744 bytes for enhanced sync performance.

metadata.explanation: Task requires configuring Thunderbird IMAP chunk size settings. Evaluator checks mail.imap.chunk_size (should be 106496) and mail.imap.min_chunk_size_threshold (should be 159744). Verified by examining the prefs.js file which shows these exact values are already set.
